fields.description: Field on the document. Each unique combination of the listed fields gets its OWN running Document No. sequence (1, 2, 3, …). custom_fiscal_year groups by the fiscal year of the posting/transaction date.
fields.label: Field

fields.description: Once a Document No. is assigned, this field can no longer be changed on the document — the save is rejected (and the form shows it read-only). Unlocked fields renumber the draft into its new group instead.
fields.label: Lock After Numbering
